title: Taiwanese American Association Of Rochester, New York 羅徹斯特台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association of Rochester, New York (羅徹斯特台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Rochester, New York area and is classified under the TAA’s East Northern (美東北) regional grouping.
